title: The keys answering a fill, or not

start: You will play with three bands, one after another. Give each one a full go; they may sound alike, and that is fine. Play each the same way.
You lead a band with your drums. The bass and keys follow you.
Play a groove for a few bars, then leave it for a bar: a fill, or the first bar of something new. Then go on, back to the groove or somewhere else.
Do this often, with different fills, and listen to what the band plays in the bar after your fill.
No pads to press: just play. To rest, stop drumming; the band keeps playing. Do not press Stop in Live.
condition: A new band. Play the same way: hold a groove for a few bars, then a fill, and listen to the bar after it.

questions.text: The band answered what I had just played
